problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 cargo shipments through 10 different customs checkpoints.

Each shipment must pass through checkpoints in a specific sequence, represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Processing time),
where each pair indicates the required checkpoint and the time needed for inspection and documentation.
The order of pairs determines the mandatory sequence for processing each shipment.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (C10, 1) → (C6, 8) → (C7, 1) → (C4, 3) → (C8, 2) → (C2, 3) → (C5, 9) → (C9, 4) → (C1, 2) → (C3, 2)
* S2 requires the sequence: (C7, 8) → (C4, 1) → (C1, 2) → (C2, 2) → (C9, 4) → (C10, 9) → (C8, 2) → (C5, 2) → (C3, 9) → (C6, 2)
* S3 requires the sequence: (C10, 6) → (C2, 5) → (C1, 3) → (C9, 8) → (C3, 3) → (C4, 6) → (C7, 4) → (C5, 4) → (C6, 3) → (C8, 10)
* S4 requires the sequence: (C7, 7) → (C8, 1) → (C10, 3) → (C1, 4) → (C5, 5) → (C2, 2) → (C9, 4) → (C6, 1) → (C4, 10) → (C3, 8)
* S5 requires the sequence: (C7, 10) → (C10, 1) → (C8, 1) → (C2, 2) → (C3, 10) → (C1, 10) → (C6, 8) → (C9, 8) → (C4, 4) → (C5, 8)
* S6 requires the sequence: (C9, 7) → (C1, 6) → (C5, 4) → (C2, 4) → (C10, 4) → (C7, 6) → (C3, 1) → (C4, 10) → (C8, 2) → (C6, 1)
* S7 requires the sequence: (C2, 8) → (C4, 8) → (C6, 8) → (C5, 4) → (C8, 10) → (C1, 2) → (C9, 9) → (C10, 9) → (C7, 3) → (C3, 2)
* S8 requires the sequence: (C6, 4) → (C3, 4) → (C2, 5) → (C10, 5) → (C9, 1) → (C4, 2) → (C7, 3) → (C1, 9) → (C5, 8) → (C8, 5)
* S9 requires the sequence: (C3, 4) → (C2, 8) → (C9, 10) → (C7, 8) → (C8, 2) → (C5, 6) → (C6, 7) → (C1, 9) → (C10, 3) → (C4, 1)
* S10 requires the sequence: (C7, 4) → (C3, 10) → (C9, 8) → (C6, 1) → (C4, 7) → (C8, 10) → (C2, 8) → (C5, 1) → (C1, 9) → (C10, 6)

Each customs inspection must proceed without interruption once it begins, and each checkpoint can only handle one shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence for all shipments at the checkpoints so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
